app.title: Vortex
app.tagline: Secure bridge between your Linux and Android

ring.tip: Ring phone: plays a sound to find it, even on silent

earbuds.add_modal_hint: Pick the Bluetooth device you'd like Vortex to track. It stays on your home screen even when disconnected.
earbuds.scan_empty: No Bluetooth devices found. Put your earbuds in pairing mode and rescan.
earbuds.remove_body: The earbuds card will go away. Your Bluetooth pairing on this device is left untouched.

switch.bring_body: The phone will release them, then this laptop will connect.
switch.send_body: This laptop will release them, then the phone will connect.

peers.title: Paired devices
peers.empty: No devices yet. Open Vortex on your Android to begin.
peers.forget_body: Stop trusting {name}? You'll need to re-pair to connect again.

scan.title: Nearby Vortex devices
scan.empty: No nearby devices found. Open the pairing window on your Android and try again.
scan.hint_open: Open Vortex on your Android to appear here.

pair.title: Pairing
pair.waiting: Accept the pairing request on your Android.
pair.sas_compare: Verify this matches the code on your phone
pair.awaiting_phone: Approve on your phone to finish pairing
pair.add_phone_modal_hint: Open Vortex on your Android phone, then tap a result below.
pair.e2e: End-to-end encrypted · just your two devices
pair.emoji_title: Make sure these match your phone
pair.emoji_body: Same three on both screens means it's really your phone, with no one in the middle.
pair.success_body: Your phone is now linked to this laptop.
pair.abort_body: The codes didn't match, so pairing stopped. Someone could be intercepting the connection. Move the devices closer and try again on a network you trust.
pair.failed_body: Could not complete the connection. Make sure Bluetooth is on and your phone is nearby with Vortex open.

settings.title: Settings
settings.smart_switch_hint: Move the earbuds to whichever device starts playing
settings.notif_mirror_hint: Show the phone's notifications on this laptop
settings.notif_send_hint: Show this laptop's notifications on the phone
settings.proximity_lock_hint: Lock this laptop when your phone goes out of Bluetooth range (only while you're idle)
settings.proximity_unlock_hint: When your phone returns, the laptop unlocks. It locks again if untouched for 90 seconds
settings.clipboard_sync_hint: Text copied on either device appears on the other. From the phone to the laptop you need the phone's Quick Settings tile.
settings.file_auto_accept_hint: Save files shared from your phone without asking. Only your paired phone can send them.
settings.uc_hint: Move the laptop cursor and keyboard onto the phone past the screen edge. Move it back to return.
settings.uc_needs: This needs USB debugging over adb and a Wayland session with the InputCapture portal (GNOME 45+, KDE Plasma 6.1+, Hyprland). Scrolling also needs uinput permission on the phone.
settings.uc_err_no_injector: No injector: the native cursor needs adb. Turn on USB debugging and allow it on the phone.
settings.uc_err_no_display_size: Could not read the phone's screen size over adb. Check that the phone still shows as a device.
settings.uc_err_no_portal: This desktop does not offer the input-capture portal, so the cursor cannot be held at the screen edge. It needs Wayland (GNOME 45+, KDE Plasma 6.1+, or Hyprland).
settings.uc_err_session_refused: The desktop refused an input-capture session.
settings.uc_err_no_zones: The desktop reported no screen areas. Reconnecting a monitor usually fixes it.
settings.uc_err_barrier_refused: Something else already holds that screen edge. Try a corner instead of the whole edge.
settings.subtitle: Manage how your phone and laptop work together.
settings.footer: End-to-end encrypted over your own link

notes.title: Notes
notes.pick_or_create: Pick a note or create one
notes.tap_complete: Tap a circle to mark done. Changes sync right away

clipboard.title: Clipboard history
clipboard.empty: Nothing copied yet. Copy something and it lands here.
clipboard.preview_empty: Select an item to preview it here.

intro.welcome_sub: Choose your language to get started.
intro.whatis_title: Your phone and laptop work together.
intro.whatis_body: Everything stays on your devices. There is no cloud copy.

feat.earbuds_body: Press play on your laptop and your Bluetooth earbuds hand off from the phone automatically.
feat.phone_body: Read notifications, calls, SMS and contacts on the desktop and reply from there.
feat.clipboard_body: Copy on one device and paste on the other. Notes and todos stay in sync.
feat.mirror_body: See the phone screen on the laptop and control it with mouse and keyboard. The phone camera can also act as a webcam.
feat.handoff_body: Open the page from your phone on the laptop in one tap.
feat.files_body: Send photos and documents between phone and laptop. They land in Downloads.
feat.proximity_body: The laptop locks when the phone leaves Bluetooth range and unlocks when it returns.

intro.privacy_body: Traffic runs over your own Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, encrypted end to end. There is no server copy.
intro.ble_tip_title: One thing for a rock-solid link
intro.ble_tip_body: Close other phone-link apps that use Bluetooth, like KDE Connect. They hold the same Bluetooth LE radio and can block Vortex from connecting.
